features.title: @Generate is found by identifier name; multi-stacking and AST-target filtering are first-class
At fixpoint, commit virtFS to disk atomically per file with stale-output purge
`sourcegen verify` detects hand-edits and regeneration drift via banner contentHash
Every emitted file carries a banner with producer / iteration / SHA-256 contentHash
GenerationContext.delta exposes a read-only view of recent virtFS activity for incremental processing
Runner converges to a fixpoint or fails at MAX_ITERATIONS, with deterministic ordering
VirtFs isolates the disk during iterations and enforces idempotent / divergence-aware addSource
Generators may only write inside outDir; addSource rejects path traversal with SG0040
